notes: Added a local atomic participation boundary that preserves OPEN-only capacity checks, exact-capacity SUCCESS transition, legacy missing-purchase error precedence, and transactional rollback semantics for missing products. The crate-visible boundary has a narrow dead-code expectation that order-create must remove when it becomes the first production caller.

notes: Direct and cart order creation now share a process-local order repository with member-scoped idempotency, atomic group-purchase participation, price snapshots, PENDING state, ten-minute expiry, local member existence checks, and cart soft-zero only after full success. Direct orders intentionally use the group purchase seller instead of the untrusted request seller. Focused tests cover concurrent replay, cross-member keys, validation, capacity, missing products, commit rollback, cart ownership, batch rollback, and cart retry. Rust fmt, check, clippy, and full tests pass; Java verification is reserved for the integration owner.
